dogecoin.text:
The rise of $DOGE is the clearest proof that people have lost faith in their local currency in general and the #usdollar in specific. 

Don’t take this lightly. The fact that 74 billion usd have been traded for the meme-dog currency should scare the shit out of you.

Its basically now or never to leave $DOGE for #Bitcoin.

Walk the plank and leave your pride behind if you didn’t sell at ATH or took a haircut. 

You want them to pay for real? This is the only way.

Since I didn’t get to be around during the fork wars, it’s nice to be able to watch the rebated Bollywood cover version playing out in real time. 

Who will get out on top? #Dogecoin or D-cash? No spoilers, please. 🍿
